decisions.quote: In summary, this work supports the association of an interaction of PRKG1 and trauma exposure with AUD symptoms in a sample of African American college students who were younger relative to the original study’s discovery and replication samples, thus extending the findings reported by Polimanti et al. (2017) .
decisions.reason: The authors state an explicit overall verdict in the Discussion summarizing their work as supporting and extending the PRKG1 x trauma interaction finding of Polimanti et al. (2017) in African Americans (and also replicating the absence of the GxE effect in European Americans). Per Rule 1 and the codebook's definition of 'mixed', an overall verdict of support governs, and a count of how many outcome measures were significant (one of three derived alcohol phenotypes in the replication sample, or loss of significance after FDR correction noted as a limitation) does not by itself make the replication outcome 'mixed'.
